English caption: Figure 2.15 (a) The first commercially successful typewriter was produced by Christopher Latham Sholes and Carlos S. Glidden; this is their 1873 prototype model. (b) The Wright brothers are among the best-known pioneers of early flight. In this photo, Orville flies over their air field in 1904.
